title: "The exercise"
subtitle: "Analyst no. 6"

This page sets out the exercise, task by task, with the tool in which each task is done. The [background page](../../background.qmd) presents the original study, the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026) and the five reanalyses. Every task is done in the IDE workspace, in your IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), on your own machine, and the [webR workspace](../../lab.qmd) holds every task as well, with hints and worked solutions, if your installation fails.

## The tasks {#the-tasks}

The route takes all five tasks: stage 1 takes Task 1, stage 3 Tasks 2 and 3, and stage 4 Tasks 4 and 5. The report of the IDE workspace, `index.qmd`, holds the steps of each task. Sending your results to the class chart is optional. Stage 5 then adds a project of your own, preregistered before it runs.
